concerns.text: T001 instructs the implementer to fetch 'the exact URL recorded in plan.md's verified-datasets block', but plan.md's verified-dataset entry is a blank placeholder ('is: ` (CPU-score text-overlap parquet)'). No task can cover FR-007/SC-006/FR-001(reframed) data ingestion because the single input the entire task list depends on does not exist in any artifact. This is the same failure mode that already caused T001/T002 to fail.

The FR-007/SC-006 minimum-row gate is circular: T001 writes 'the minimum' into provenance.json and T002 checks against it — no task fixes or justifies a concrete minimum from any upstream source, so SC-006 ('measured against the [deferred]-page minimum') has no covering task that makes it testable.

concerns.location: tasks.md:coverage table vs spec.md:FR-001, FR-004, FR-005, US-1 Scenario 2, US-2 Scenario 1, Key Entities
concerns.text: Tasks cover only the REFRAMED requirements; spec.md still mandates the visual-encoder mechanism (FR-001), 'predicted visual latents' (FR-004), table-QA reasoning tasks (FR-005/ReasoningTask), the cosine/KL divergence check (US-1 Sc.2), and MSE ≥5% lower at p<0.05 (US-2 Sc.1) — none of which have any task, and the required spec amendments the plan itself lists have not been applied. As written, the task list cannot satisfy the spec it claims to cover.

The leakage gate's correlation threshold is '[deferred] value set at implementation' and no task fixes, justifies, or pre-registers it; T007's verification only requires the block be 'populated'. Whether the primary hypothesis (FR-005/SC-002/SC-003) is interpretable hinges on this unspecified threshold, so the gate has no complete covering task.

Plan's project structure places contracts under 'specs/001-llmxive-layout-distillation/contracts/' while tasks reference 'specs/001-llmxive-follow-up-extending-scalable-vis/contracts/'; the path mismatch means the contract-validation tasks (T002, T008) point at schemas the plan's structure won't produce.
